name: check_budget
title: Check budget
description: Is a cost centre open, and how much budget is left this quarter? Without a code, lists every open cost centre.

cost_centre.description: cost centre code, e.g. PRD-07; leave out to list the open ones

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

available.description: budget left this quarter, in pounds (GBP)
